mentions.name: Temp Mail Detector WordPress plugin
mentions.description: A WordPress plugin from Temp Mail Detector that blocks temporary/disposable email addresses at signup, offering site owners the option to input their own block lists, use a pre-existing list, or rely on a constantly updated detection API.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on https://tempmaildetector.com and more specifically a Wordpress plugin to support it: https://wordpress.org/plugins/temp-mail-detector-block-temporary-emails/

The plugin offers users a way to input their own block lists, a pre-existing one, or make use of the API which is constantly getting updated.
